Name: Mouse to WASD (accessibility)
Author: ConsensusAi
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I'm disabled so using the keyboard isn't the easiest for me and sometimes I just want to use the mouse to play games like this, but they usually require WASD for movement so I created a Autohotkey script that translates mouse movement to WASD. (this will work with any 
game)

[b]Controls[/b]
Toggle script on/off with: ] Exit script with: [

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Install Autohotkey
2. double click the script

[b]Main features[/b]
Able to control overworld character movement without keyboard

[b]Requirements[/b]
Autohotkey: https://www.autohotkey.com/
